prayerExcerpt.en-US: "A servant of the poor, instead of being ashamed of what she does in their service, ought to glory in it."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Uma serva dos pobres, em vez de se envergonhar do que faz a serviço deles, deve gloriar-se disso."

meta.face: A Veronese of about fifty with a pale, warm complexion and a LONG, NARROW OVAL face — a high, smooth forehead under the band, a LONG, PROMINENT nose with a high, straight bridge and a slightly DOWNTURNED tip, large dark eyes with HEAVY upper lids glancing a little to one side, thin, finely arched brows, flat cheeks, a SMALL, thin-lipped mouth with a faint, wry smile at one corner, and a small, rounded chin; the gaze quiet, perceptive and kind. Not the sloping, sorrowful brows of maria_santocanale, nor the square chin and wide mouth of elena_guerra.
meta.basis: No photograph exists (she died in 1855); her two nineteenth-century painted portraits (Wikimedia Commons) and the Dicastery's portrait drawn from one agree: a long, narrow oval face with a long, prominent nose, heavy-lidded dark eyes glancing aside, fine arched brows and a small, thin mouth with a faint smile, in a black habit and hooded black veil with a broad square white collar, her hand on her breast. The Dicastery records her community's beginning at the Pio Ricovero of Verona in 1840.
meta.excerpt: Her words to a novice, «Una serva dei poveri, anziché vergognarsi di ciò che fa in servizio loro, se ne deve gloriare», among the sayings eyewitnesses handed down, on the Dicastery's page; the first sentence, our rendering (she died in 1855)
